game_updates.title: Manor Lords celebrates 4 million copies sold with a new major update which gives players the chance to become 'a cow-herding mogul'
game_updates.contents: Manor Lords is on a roll—with the medieval management sim celebrating the monumental milestone of over 4 million copies sold across all stores. And to commemorate the good news comes its next major update... Read more.

game_updates.title: Major Update #8: Wide Valley, Cows, Cider, Advanced Construction & More
game_updates.contents: Hey everyone, The latest update has successfully went through all the community Beta testing and is now ready for the main branch. For a summary of what we worked on, you can check out the previously published preview here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1363080/view/677378351435875655 Steam Reviews: Your Feedback MattersI've been reading a lot of reviews lately about the lack of new content, I hope this is at least a sign of a positive direction and if your review was negative, maybe we managed to change your mind. If not, I can only say, work continues. The next update is planned for late September and will include a bunch of new Perks. You can report feedback and bug reports on the Manor Lords Steam forums or join us on Discord for bug reports and discussion about the latest pa...

game_updates.title: We're still cooking for 1.0. Here's some news you may have missed!
game_updates.contents: Hi Flameborn!Our October 15th release date is almost close enough to touch, being a little over 6 weeks away, so we've started sharing some of the changes we're making to Enshrouded. For now, we're focusing on existing stuff, and how we're improving features and systems that are already in the game. The improvements mentioned in the following video are just some of the bigger changes we're making, with a much longer list waiting for you in the Highlights video (and the release changelog) in October!The other big challenge we're tackling for 1.0 is making Enshrouded's performance better, after years of adding systems, details, making the thing more beautiful, etc. We really wanted to get the game to perform much better including on lower and middle-range systems, especially because someone ...

game_updates.title: Incoming Update: A Royal Wardrobe
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Queens and Kings, The finest tailors and blacksmiths from the realm have gathered to provide you with new attire to don while you protect your little Kingdom against your furious foes! Coming soon, in this update you’ll be able to customize your Ruler’s appearance. Choose from a range of crowns, armour and capes, then truly make them your own with unique colours and patterns. Of course your mount gets their own gear too… We want to thank you for your dedication, enthusiasm, and protection of the realm. We’re excited to share more updates with you all soon. In the meantime, make sure you join our official Discord channel and follow our socials for the latest updates from the Kingdom! See you on the battlefield come nightfall. The Mythwright team. game_updates.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered includes work from a top modder, as CD Projekt Red follow the path they walked with the RPG's next-gen update
game_updates.contents: As revealed earlier this week alongside a look at next year's Songs of the Past expansion, The Witcher 3 is getting a free remastered update next month. As with 2022's next-gen update, some of its tweaks and additions are the work of modders, with the creator of The Witcher 3's HD Reworked Project having revealed that they got the call to collaborate with CD Projekt Red again. Read more

game_updates.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Tactics Is Revealed
game_updates.contents: TACTICAL. TURN-BASED. RAINBOW SIX. Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a single-player, turn-based tactical game set in the iconic Rainbow Six universe. Step into the role of commander, rebuild the unit, and deploy elite operators across dangerous missions worldwide to stop a shadowy conspiracy. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621390 COMMAND OPERATOR SQUADS IN TENSE BATTLES https://ubistatic-a.akamaihd.net/0175/CRM/STEAM/SND/V1_B2.gif Assemble squads of operators, each with signature abilities and gear. Analyze the battlefield with recon tools, choose your approach, take part in tense, turn-based tactical battles, and use destructible environments to create new opportunities. Learn more

game_updates.game_name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
game_updates.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered: Everything new coming in the big free upgrade
game_updates.contents: fter 11 years, The Witcher 3 is getting a new story expansion and a remaster. CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered, which is coming in 2026 and will be a free upgrade for all current owners of the game, paving the way for the shiny new DLC coming next year. It isn't just a technical update, either: CDPR is making changes to The Witcher 3's combat, skill system, and hey, transmogs!.. Read more.

game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 8/26/2026
game_updates.contents: FIXED:-Octane passive once again restores him to full health, as intended.-Fixed rare instances where players were locked out of nearly all actions in Battle Royale mode.-Fixed an instance where Gibraltar could sprint faster than intended when combining Fast Shotties perk with the Corrupted Stock.-Fixed an issue where players would sometimes experience rubberbanding, jumpy behaviour and/or jittery movement after reconnecting.

game_updates.title: August Hotfix
game_updates.contents: Greetings Everyone, Today we have a quick hotfix, 2.1.1 fixing the following issues that appeared after the 2.1.0 patch.Fix for losing purchased Bazaar items due to clock sync.The Ferine Stalker Staff no longer drops outside the Headhunter event.Added redirectors to prevent some mods from crashing.Dev Kit - Added missing SetOwnerStableId for ThrallComponent.Dev Kit - Fixed issue where some mods with custom animations were crashing on game load.

game_updates.title: Yet Another Update 1.0.0c (HOTFIX)
game_updates.contents: Welcome, Survivor! We're releasing a hotfix update for some of the issues reported and feedback received since the version 1.0.0b, with the following changes: Additions: Reintroduced the option to delete/reset the first save game profile at the "Change Save Slot" interface. "Remap Controls" setting in Options -> Controls now allows you to bind "Speed up" and "Slow down" hotkeys (remember, that speeds below 100% automatically disable the Leaderboards). "FPS Counter" setting was added in Options -> Interface. "Hide Build Version" setting was added in Options -> Interface (also hides the "Press F8 to submit feedback" text where applicable). Changes: New missions now appear in the Mission Log after reading their brief, without having to play them (this should make it easier/smoother to switch ...

game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 8/25/2026
game_updates.contents: INVESTIGATING: We are investigating a crash impacting players with AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT GPUs. For immediate resolution, please roll back your drivers to the previous version (26.7.1).

game_updates.title: CD Projekt Red sweeten the Witcher 3 Songs of the Past honeypot with a free base game remaster, and, oh yeah, both original expansions too
game_updates.contents: Hey kid, you want a free remaster? It's totally not a scam! No, really. While everyone knew The Witcher 3's sort of surprise new expansion Songs of the Past would be getting a look-in at Geoff: German Edition, CD Projekt Red had another surprise up their sleeve in the form of a full-on remaster of The Witcher 3, which is coming as a free update next month. game_updates.contents: Heroes!As promised, the Feast of Grimnir event has returned! From August 25 to September 6, venture forth into Karak Dal once again to slay every troll in sight and make Cousin Okri proud! For the duration of the event, select the Weekly Event game mode in the Adventure map to launch the Feast of Grimnir mission! Complete the mission to progress in various repeatable Event Quests found in Okri’s Book and receive shillings and chests!Make sure to also check Lohner’s Emporium of Wonders for time-limited access to previous event rewards, purchasable for shillings! game_updates.title: Full Release 7.27.6 Released! (Experimental)
game_updates.contents: This update is only accessible by switching to our Experimental branches (instructions on how to do so here). This is a minor update that is designed to tidy up a few issues with the mod manager panel to make life easier for those working on mods.Bugfixes:Updated the visuals / layout of the Mod Manager panel to make it easier to use.The Mod Manager panel now shows more extensive details when there is an issue with a mod, including: Each enabled mod has a red or green circle next to it. Green indicates no problems, whereas red indicates an issue with dependencies, conflicts or versions.Viewing the mod shows the required game version, and any other mods required to make the mod function (dependencies). game_updates.title: 2026.1 Patch 21
game_updates.contents: Dear captains, There is a new patch available for update 2026.1. Changelog: Missions: - Fix: In Enigma recovery assignment, if the wreck disappears for any reason, it's respawned where it should be. - Fix: Resolved general issue that could break mission scripts. - Fix: Mission with upgrading from Type IIA U-boat wasn't progressing as intended when port menu was open. - Fix: Blockade in the assignment with planting the mines, where objective was asking to free up space for 0 mines. The major changes include: Security and stability improvements Fixed a bug where certain custom maps would not load assets correctly on Linux
